saints.name: Damasus
saints.legacy: Promoter of the Vulgate and Church unity
saints.summary: Saint Damasus I served as Pope from 366 to 384 and is known for his efforts to combat Arianism and Apollinarianism. He commissioned Saint Jerome to produce the Vulgate, a significant Latin translation of the Bible. Damasus also worked to beautify the Church and honor the martyrs, leaving a lasting legacy in the history of the Catholic Church.
